title: Estimate Deflection
tagline: Bend the ski under a load case: an EI curve, up to three supports and two applied loads, each spread over a width -- out comes the deflected shape.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Flex numbers are one load case. Estimate Deflection solves any: a bench test, a skier's weight fore and aft, a binding plate. Curvature = M / EI integrated twice gives the shape, zero at supports 1 and 2.
useWhen: Predict a bench or on-snow deflection
See the effect of a binding plate or mounting moment
Find the EI that would give a shape (drag the curvature)
slides.caption: Test2: supports at +-700 mm, 60 N and 20 N loads -> 14.6 mm.

slides.title: The dialog
params: The EI curve: an edge in the XZ plane, world Z in mm = EI in N m^2 (EI and Cross Section's <name>_EI, a measured or a target curve).
Drag curvature handles; outputs the matching EI (altered_EI).
Plate stiffness edge, reaction moment (N m, positive) and its x.
Load 3-600 N, balance between two loads; each: location, shape, width.
Supports 1, 2 (optional 3 with its share); each: location, shape, width.
Span (full EI / supports); Fit or Approximate.

points.head: Spread over a width
points.body: Each shape integrates to the load's force.

points.head: Supports too
points.body: Reactions can be spread (Logistic suits a support pad).

points.head: Known bug
points.body: Every distributed shape is computed as Logistic today (enum compared with strings). Point is correct.

slides.title: Example: Test2
slides.head: EI eiTarget; supports x = -700 / 700; 80 N split 0.75: 60 N at -125, 20 N at 250 (100 mm wide)
slides.body: The deflection_curve sags 14.6 mm near the middle. With 'Alter deformed beam curvature' on, the dragged shape gives altered_EI (dotted).

keys: The deflected shape, Z = deflection, true scale.
Optional: the EI curve that gives the dragged curvature (EI format).
messages: fewer than 2 EI samples / all EI zero
supports 1 and 2 at the same x / zero span

items.head: Load shapes
items.body: Until fixed, Constant / Linear / Quadratic / Quintic all behave as Logistic.

items.head: Support 3
items.body: Takes a fixed share of the load; the deflection is zero only at supports 1 and 2.

items.head: Moment
items.body: The reaction moment cannot be negative.
